jobs.description:
Overview
Microsoft is the world’s center of expertise on topological quantum computing. We are building a scaled, fault‑tolerant quantum computer grounded in topological qubits and integrated end‑to‑end with the Azure Quantum software stack.
As a Senior Quantum Systems Electrical Engineer, you’ll collaborate closely with quantum physicists, systems software, RF/EE, and manufacturing/production to help define, design, and deliver FPGA‑based, ultra‑low‑latency digital subsystems that sit at the heart of our topological quantum engine—spanning readout classification, error‑decoder acceleration, room‑temperature front‑ends for cryogenic control, high‑speed interconnects, and precision clocking networks. Your work will directly impact logical‑qubit stability, throughput, and system scale.
At Microsoft Quantum, we aim to empower science and scientists to solve the world’s biggest problems by realizing advanced computing platforms at the intersection of high-performance computing, artificial intelligence, and quantum information technology. Microsoft Quantum will change the world of computing and help solve some of humankind’s currently unsolvable problems. For more information about our team, visit https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/quantum.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities
• Design & implement Prototype Circuits and PCBs for custom electronics devices, high speed digital (FPGA based) designs, RF designs, and mixed signal electronics.
• Verification and validation: develop and document tests to validate custom circuits at the component and system level. Support lab bring‑up of new designs with scopes, VNAs, LA/SC, and RF instruments.
• Tool flow & CI: support CI pipeline standup and assist with test development.
• Quality & documentation: produce clear design docs, interface specs, and bring‑up guides; participate in rigorous code/design reviews.

Within CO&I, the Datacenter Engineering (DCE) team is responsible for delivering core datacenter infrastructure for Microsoft’s cloud business. In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.

Responsibilities

This role will involve supporting Microsoft’s datacenter Technical Excellence program and projects globally. jobs.description:
NVIDIA’s Clocks team is looking for an experienced ASIC Design Verification engineer to join our team!
The NVIDIA Clocks Team is committed to deliver high-quality clocking and reset logic to various units in SOC and GPU ASIC. The complexity of the clocks and resets design has increased many folds. This requires sophisticated verification to deliver a bug free clocks design to power our product lines ranging from Data Centers, Consumer graphics to Self-driving cars and the growing field of artificial intelligence. Modern clocking verification solutions need to be innovative, ensure quality in covering the complex design specifications and balance the constraints on infrastructure, re-usability, testing speed and multi-platform support.

What you'll be doing:
• Own validation of Clocking structures in Tegra and GPU products from start to finish, including test plan development, automation, validation flows development, coverage metrics, test execution, bug identification/fix and productization.
• Tackle Sophisticated problems and develop a scalable solution that works across platform.
• Hands on industry-standard tools and state of the art verification methodologies. This includes coding in System Verilog, UVM, C++, Perl, Python and NVIDIA custom compilers and tools.
• Partnering closely with our clocks architecture and design team to validate our clocks design.
• Coordinate with internal and external teams across time zones.

What we need to see:
• BS or MS in EE/ECE or equivalent experience
• 3+ years of proven design verification experience
• Good understanding of Logic Design and Architecture
• Expertise in industry-standard verification flows like SV constraint random verification, UVM, Formal Verification, Coverage metrics, profiling tools, X prop, etc
• Exposure on block level and system-level verification
• Strong coding skills in System Verilog, scripting languages (Perl/python), and C++
• Ability to collaborate and work with multiple groups
• Prior experience in implementing Test plans for pre-silicon platforms

What to Stand Out From the Crowd:
• Previous experience automating tasks in the design verification process
• Hands on experience in object-oriented programming
• Prior design or verification experience at the IP or block level
• Experience developing methodologies used by others
• Demonstrated ability to drive a project to completion
We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our world-class engineering teams are growing fast. If you are creative, curious, and motivated with real passion for technology, we want to hear from you!

THE ROLE:
• As a Lead IP Verification Engineer in the AECG Group, you will help bring to life cutting-edge FPGA and ASIC solutions for a broad range of customers.

• You are passionate about complex IP architectures, digital design, and advanced verification methodologies.

• Develop comprehensive verification plans that address feature interactions, hardware/software integration, performance requirements, and system-level use cases.

jobs.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER.
ADVANCE THE WORLD.
At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better.
It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us.
And we’re looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don’t shy away from humanity’s challenges but are determined to help solve them.
AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high-performance computing, cloud, and AI.
Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go-to-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward.
THE ROLE As a Senior Engineer for AMD Vivado™ Design Tools, you will serve as the technical owner for verification methodology and simulation technologies, with a primary focus on UVM, SystemVerilog, HDL simulation, and technical product strategy.
You will lead the evolution of Vivado's simulation ecosystem, helping customers develop, verify, and deploy complex FPGA and adaptive SoC designs with industry-leading methodologies and tools.
In this highly visible role, you will bridge engineering, product planning, and technical marketing by defining product direction, influencing verification methodologies, and representing AMD to strategic customers and industry partners.
You will own the roadmap for UVM-based verification flows, HDL simulation (VHDL, Verilog, and SystemVerilog), Vivado Simulator capabilities, RTL encryption/IP protection, and deployment technologies including installation, licensing, and software delivery.
Working closely with R&D, Applications Engineering, Sales, and key customers, you will translate real-world verification challenges into product innovations that improve productivity, interoperability, and customer success.
We operate with an AI-first engineering mindset and encourage the use of AI agents and copilots to accelerate product development, customer enablement, and engineering workflows.
THE PERSON You are recognized as a technical leader in digital design verification, with deep expertise in UVM, SystemVerilog, and modern simulation methodologies.
Beyond your technical depth, you're motivated by shaping product direction, influencing engineering organizations, and working directly with strategic customers to solve their most complex verification challenges.
You can seamlessly transition between defining long-term product strategy, collaborating with engineering teams on new capabilities, presenting verification methodologies at technical conferences, and supporting executive-level customer engagements.
You understand both the technical and business aspects of EDA tools and have a passion for improving verification productivity across the FPGA and adaptive computing ecosystem.
You thrive in highly collaborative environments, influence without formal authority, and are comfortable driving initiatives that span engineering, product management, applications engineering, sales, and executive leadership.
Your combination of verification expertise, customer focus, and strategic thinking enables you to shape the future of AMD's verification and simulation capabilities.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Product Planning: Shape the strategic roadmap for simulation, RTL encryption/security, and deployment — translating customer needs, competitive dynamics, and technology trends into a coherent product vision across annual and quarterly planning cycles.
• Drive competitive differentiation by deeply understanding the market landscape — where AMD leads, where we’re challenged, and what moves will create the most customer value.
• Define third-party partnership strategy (Xcelium, Questa, Riviera) — ensuring interoperability, certification, and commercial alignment that strengthens the AMD ecosystem.
• Represent AMD in industry standards bodies for IP protection and encryption, influencing the direction of the standards our customers depend on.
• Own licensing and deployment strategy end-to-end — from commercial model innovation and architecture decisions to Legal/compliance alignment and enterprise scalability.
• Technical Marketing: Be the bridge between R&D innovation and customer success — turning complex simulation, security, and deployment capabilities into clear methodology guidance, enablement content, and compelling positioning.
• Drive technical thought leadership at flagship events and through direct customer engagements that shape both AMD’s reputation and our product direction.
• Serve as the primary technical resource for strategic sales opportunities — enabling complex deals with deep domain expertise and customer-facing credibility.
• Ensure AMD’s simulation, encryption, and deployment guidance reflects real-world customer complexity — validating flows, publishing authoritative documentation, and continuously raising the bar on technical accuracy.
• Senior/Strategic: Operate as a senior technical leader across the organization — influencing VP/CVP decisions, representing the team in executive forums, and driving cross-functional alignment on initiatives that span Engineering, Sales, Legal, and Support.
• Lead high-stakes customer escalations with executive-level communication and resolution ownership.
• Elevate the team through mentorship, knowledge sharing, and by modeling what great customer engagement looks like.

About Intel & Silicon Chassis
Intel is seeking an Entry Level Design Verification Engineer for the Silicon Chassis team. In this role, you will contribute to the verification of next-generation interconnect and chassis IPs that underpin Intel's most ambitious SoC and platform products.

Position Overview
You will work alongside senior engineers to build testbenches, write constrained-random tests, close functional coverage, and root-cause simulation failures - developing end-to-end verification skills from day one.
We look for engineers who think algorithmically, write clean code, and are excited to apply the latest AI-assisted development tools as a core part of how they work. You do not need to know everything on day one; you do need strong fundamentals, genuine curiosity, and the drive to ramp fast.

• Develop testbench components, constrained-random stimulus, and functional checkers for interconnect and chassis IP under guidance of senior engineers
• Write, run, and debug simulation tests; analyze failures and root-cause issues to closure with clear technical write-ups
• Contribute to functional coverage plans, coverage closure analysis, and regression triage
• Participate in spec reviews, design discussions, and bug triage; learn to contribute across architecture, design, and software boundaries
• Use AI-assisted coding and debugging tools as an everyday part of development workflow; actively contribute to the team's productivity through automation and scripting
• Continuously build depth in hardware design, verification methodology, and the chip development flow

You should demonstrate the following professional traits to be successful:
• Genuine curiosity and the drive to ramp fast
• Algorithmic thinking with a commitment to writing clean code
• Enthusiasm for applying the latest AI-assisted development tools as a core part of how you work

jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

The Opportunity
For nearly a decade, Intel's Neuromorphic Computing Lab-together with a global ecosystem of 250+ research groups-has explored architectures, algorithms, and software inspired by the brain's extraordinary efficiency, scalability, and adaptability. Our Loihi series of research chips pioneered event-driven, sparse, and massively parallel neuro-inspired processing, fueling over 100 peer-reviewed publications that validate the promise of this novel approach.
Now, we're entering an exciting new chapter: transforming these breakthroughs into real-world products that will power the coming era of physical AI systems-beyond the reach of GPUs and mainstream AI accelerators.
If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of computing, from transistor-level innovation to software abstractions, join us. Help define the next wave of AI technology that harnesses the proven advantages of Intel's neuromorphic computing technology with the versatility demanded by modern AI workloads.

Position Overview
We are seeking experienced pre-silicon verification engineers who are passionate about driving innovation at the intersection of advanced semiconductor technologies, physical AI and next-generation computing architectures. As a member of Intel's neuromorphic silicon team, you will develop and scale verification methodologies spanning software, RTL, and emulation platforms to validate these novel architectures.
This role requires a full-stack verification mindset. You will create application-driven workloads using high-level software APIs while also developing robust HDL-based verification environments that ensure correctness at the lowest levels of hardware implementation. Working closely with architecture, design, and software teams, you will help drive verification strategies that enable first-pass silicon success.
An openness to learning new technologies and methodologies, such as asynchronous design techniques and AI-driven verification automation, is essential.

Responsibilities
• Mapping application-level requirements to unit- and system-level test plans.
• Write Python-based directed and random tests for design partitions and chip-level.
• Running regressions, debugging test failures, tracking coverage and working with designers to fix failures and improve coverage.
• Maintaining assertions, scoreboards and any tools/flows that are developed.
• Integrating VIPs and coordinating with IP teams to ensure protocol requirements are met.

Qualifications:

Minimum qualifications
• Bachelors and 5+ years OR Masters and 3+ years of silicon engineering experience.
• 3+ years of pre-silicon verification or post-silicon validation experience in SoC accelerators or custom ASIC designs.
• 3+ years of experience in UVM and constrained random verification methods.
• 2+ years of experience developing the entire verification stack from test planning to execution, e.g. covering test development, coverage tracking, emulation, and post-silicon.
• 1+ year of experience using AI tools for test generation, debugging and improving overall productivity.

Preferred qualifications
• Experienced in neuromorphic computing or AI/ML accelerator design.
• Experience with commercial Verification IPs for standard IO interfaces, PHYs, and protocols such as Ethernet, PCIE, MACsec/IPsec, RoCEv2, MIPI CSI-2, JESD204.
• Experience with DFX, low power and UPF verification techniques.

jobs.description:
Company:
Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.

Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > ASICS Engineering

General Summary:
Qualcomm is seeking a motivated and experienced Design Verification Engineer to join its memory subsystem verification team. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive verification strategies for complex digital designs, including memory controllers, DDR/LPDDR/HBM and custom memory interfaces, PHY-related logic, and other high-performance memory subsystem components.
This role involves the complete verification lifecycle—from understanding design specifications and developing verification plans to creating UVM-based testbenches, developing assertions, executing simulations, debugging failures, and driving functional and code coverage closure.
The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with Verilog, SystemVerilog, UVM, and SystemVerilog Assertions, along with an interest in memory technologies such as LPDDR, DDR, HBM, and JEDEC specifications.

Key Responsibilities
• Develop verification strategies, test plans, and coverage plans for complex RTL designs.
• Build, enhance, and maintain reusable SystemVerilog/UVM and formal verification environments.
• Develop and maintain UVM components, including:
• Sequences and sequence libraries
• Drivers and monitors
• Scoreboards and reference models
• Agents, environments, and test configurations
• Functional coverage models
• Create and execute constrained-random, directed, error-injection, and corner-case tests.
• Write and maintain SystemVerilog Assertions for protocol, interface, timing, and functional verification.
• Verify memory-controller, PHY-interface, and memory-subsystem functionality across multiple operating modes.
• Analyze simulation failures using waveform viewers, simulation logs, transaction databases, and other debug tools.
• Perform root-cause analysis of verification failures and collaborate with RTL, architecture, modeling, and integration teams to resolve issues.
• Review RTL, microarchitecture specifications, interface definitions, and design changes for functional correctness, completeness, and verifiability.
• Support regression execution, failure triage, failure classification, and verification status reporting.
• Drive functional, code, assertion, and coverage closure.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including architecture, design, physical design, firmware, modeling, and system validation teams.

Required Qualifications
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
• 3–10 years of experience in ASIC, SoC, IP, or subsystem design verification.

• Verilog
• SystemVerilog
• UVM

• Experience developing and debugging reusable UVM-based verification environments.
• Proficiency in developing UVM components such as sequences, drivers, monitors, scoreboards, agents, and functional coverage models.
• Experience with constrained-random verification and coverage-driven verification methodologies.
• Experience writing assertions for protocol compliance, temporal behavior, interface checking, and functional correctness.
• Strong understanding of digital design and verification fundamentals, including clocking, reset behavior, synchronous and asynchronous logic, and multi-clock-domain designs.
• Experience with simulation-based verification, waveform analysis, regression execution, and failure debug.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience verifying LPDDR, DDR, DDR PHY, HBM, custom memory interfaces.
• Familiarity with JEDEC memory specifications and memory-protocol requirements.
• Understanding of memory-controller, memory-subsystem, and PHY architecture.
• Familiarity with integrating and configuring industry-standard verification IP.
• Experience working with commercial or internally developed memory models.
• Experience with power-aware simulation using UPF.
• Knowledge of standard interfaces such as AXI, APB, AHB, DFI, or similar protocols.
• Experience with formal verification or assertion-based verification methodologies.
• Experience verifying high-performance, low-power, or multi-clock-domain designs.
• Experience with performance verification, including bandwidth, latency, throughput, efficiency, QoS, and stress testing of memory subsystems.
• Familiarity with hardware/software co-verification or system-level validation.
• Experience with memory training, initialization, refresh, power-management, frequency-switching, calibration, or error-handling scenarios.

Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Science, Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience.

Master's degree in Science, Engineering, or related field and 3+ years of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience.

General Summary:

In this role, you will be responsible for verifying next-generation Data Center SoCs that power AI, high-performance computing, and cloud infrastructure products. You will work closely with architects, design engineers, software teams, and verification specialists to develop scalable verification solutions, drive verification closure, and ensure first-silicon success for complex SoC designs.
This position offers the opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies including multi-core CPUs, cache coherency systems, memory subsystems, AI/ML accelerators, high-speed interconnects, security, and advanced SoC architecture.

Key Responsibilities:
• Develop and execute comprehensive verification plans for SoC, subsystem, and IP-level features.
• Design and implement scalable System Verilog/UVM-based and Processor-based verification environments.
• Create directed and constrained-random test scenarios to validate functionality and architectural use cases.
• Develop assertions, functional coverage models, and checkers.
• Debug RTL, testbench, and integration issues and work closely with design teams to resolve defects.
• Drive coverage closure using functional and code coverage metrics.
• Participate in architecture and design reviews to ensure verification requirements are incorporated early in the development cycle.
• Verify complex Data Center SoC features including:
• Multi-core CPU systems
• Cache coherency and interconnect fabrics
• DDR/HBM memory subsystems
• PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, and high-speed interfaces
• Security, RAS, and power-management features
• Support emulation and acceleration-based verification when required.
• Contribute to methodology improvements, automation, reusable verification components, and AI-assisted verification flows.

Qualifications
• Bachelor's or master's degree in electrical engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
• Minimum 2+ years of design verification experience* Senior positions to be offered to candidates with proven expertise in the relevant field
• Strong knowledge of: System Verilog, UVM, C, Assertion-Based Verification (SVA), Coverage-Driven Verification, System level Use case verification
• Experience developing verification environments from architecture/specification through signoff.
• Strong understanding of computer architecture and digital design fundamentals.
• Experience debugging complex SoC-level issues.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with one or more of the following:
• CPU verification
• Cache coherency protocols (ACE, CHI, CXL)
• DDR or HBM memory systems
• PCIe, Ethernet, or networking protocols
• AI/ML accelerator verification
• Security and RAS feature verification
• System Performance verification
• System Power verification
• ATE and Post Silicon bring up testing
• Experience with:
• Portable Stimulus (PSS)

• Proficiency in Python or scripting languages for automation.
• AI-assisted verification of workflows and test generation.

Preferred Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate is a hands-on verification engineer who is passionate about solving complex technical challenges and delivering high-quality silicon. They should possess strong debugging skills, a solid understanding of SoC architecture, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Why Join Us?
You will be part of a team developing next-generation Data Center Solutions -
Qualcomm Dragonfly CPU, Qualcomm High Bandwidth Compute (HBC), Qualcomm Dragonfly AI Inference Accelerator. This involves hardware design verification of advanced CPUs, Memory architecture, AI Accelerators, and high-speed connectivity technologies. jobs.description:
Company:
Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.

Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > ASICS Engineering

General Summary:
We are seeking highly motivated and experienced Design Verification Engineers to join our Data Center SoC Verification team. In this role, you will be responsible for verifying next-generation Data Center SoCs that power AI, high-performance computing, and cloud infrastructure products. You will work closely with architects, design engineers, software teams, and verification specialists to develop scalable verification solutions, drive verification closure, and ensure first-silicon success for complex SoC designs.
This position offers the opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies including multi-core CPUs, cache coherency systems, memory subsystems, AI/ML accelerators, high-speed interconnects, security, and advanced SoC architecture.

Key Responsibilities:
• Develop and execute comprehensive verification plans for SoC, subsystem, and IP-level features.
• Design and implement scalable System Verilog/UVM-based and Processor-based verification environments.
• Create directed and constrained-random test scenarios to validate functionality and architectural use cases.
• Develop assertions, functional coverage models, and checkers.
• Debug RTL, testbench, and integration issues and work closely with design teams to resolve defects.
• Drive coverage closure using functional and code coverage metrics.
• Participate in architecture and design reviews to ensure verification requirements are incorporated early in the development cycle.
• Verify complex Data Center SoC features including:
• Multi-core CPU systems
• Cache coherency and interconnect fabrics
• DDR/HBM memory subsystems
• PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, and high-speed interfaces
• Security, RAS, and power-management features
• Support emulation and acceleration-based verification when required.
• Contribute to methodology improvements, automation, reusable verification components, and AI-assisted verification flows.

Qualifications
• Bachelor's or master's degree in electrical engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
• Minimum 2+ years of design verification experience* Senior positions to be offered to candidates with proven expertise in the relevant field
• Strong knowledge of: System Verilog, UVM, C, Assertion-Based Verification (SVA), Coverage-Driven Verification, System level Use case verification
• Experience developing verification environments from architecture/specification through signoff.
• Strong understanding of computer architecture and digital design fundamentals.
• Experience debugging complex SoC-level issues.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with one or more of the following:
• CPU verification
• Cache coherency protocols (ACE, CHI, CXL)
• DDR or HBM memory systems
• PCIe, Ethernet, or networking protocols
• AI/ML accelerator verification
• Security and RAS feature verification
• System Performance verification
• System Power verification
• ATE and Post Silicon bring up testing
• Experience with:
• Portable Stimulus (PSS)
• Formal Verification
• Emulation platforms (Veloce/Palladium/ZeBu)
• Power-aware verification
• Proficiency in Python or scripting languages for automation.
• AI-assisted verification of workflows and test generation.
• Experience in full-chip or subsystem verification environments.

Preferred Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate is a hands-on verification engineer who is passionate about solving complex technical challenges and delivering high-quality silicon. They should possess strong debugging skills, a solid understanding of SoC architecture, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Why Join Us?
You will be part of a team developing next-generation Data Center Solutions -
Qualcomm Dragonfly CPU, Qualcomm High Bandwidth Compute (HBC), Qualcomm Dragonfly AI Inference Accelerator. This involves hardware design verification of advanced CPUs, Memory architecture, AI Accelerators, and high-speed connectivity technologies. This role offers significant growth opportunities while working alongside industry-leading engineers on some of the most challenging SoC verification problems in the semiconductor industry.

General Summary:
As a Design Verification Engineer, you will work with Chip Architects to validate the concepts of CPU and SOC level micro-architectures. You will work on a selected part of the CPU Design Verification to ensure that it functions to the standards of being launch ready for the end Product.

Role and Responsibilities
• Work with CPU and SOC Architects to understand the concepts and high-level system requirements.
• Develop detailed Test and Coverage plans based on the Architecture and Micro-architecture.
• Develop Verification Methodology, ensuring scalability and portability across environments.
• Develop Verification environment, including all the respective components such as Stimulus, Checkers, Assertions, Trackers, and Coverage.
• Develop Verification Plans and Testbenches for your functional domain.
• Execute Verification Plans, including Design Bring-up, DV environment Bring-up, Regressions enabling all features under your care, and Debug of the test failures.
• Track and report DV progress using a variety of metrics, including Bugs and Coverage.

Extensive knowledge of industry Instruction Set Architectures, particularly RISC-V
• Deep knowledge of Micro-Processor Verification functions and Architectures, in domains such as: Cache Coherence, Memory ordering and Consistency, Prefetching, Branch Prediction, Renaming, Speculative execution, and Address Translation/Memory Management.
• Knowledge of Random Instruction Sequencing (RIS) and testing a given design, at the Block/Unit-level and Subsystem/Chip-level for proving correctness.
• Experience in leading a small team of Verification engineers performing CPU Verification.
• Advance techniques such as: Formal, Assertions, and Silicon bringup, is helpful.
• In-depth knowledge of Micro-processor functions, Architectures, and Micro-architectures.
• Experience in writing Test plans, portable Testbenches, Transactors, and Assembly code.
• Experience with different Verification Methodologies and Tools such as Simulators, Coverage collection, Gate-level Simulation, Waveform viewers, and Mixed signal Verification.

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Junior/Senior Emulation Engineer to support the development and validation of complex ASIC and FPGA-based designs. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in hardware emulation, RTL verification, system-level debugging, and software-hardware co-validation. • Create automation scripts and workflows using Python to improve productivity, regression execution, and debug efficiency.
• Collaborate with design teams to optimize designs for emulation performance and resource utilization.

General Summary:
Are you interested in working with a world-class CPU design team? Are you interested in the application of formal methods to the verification of application processors? In contributing to the development of the next generation of formal methodologies in this space? The Qualcomm CPU team has some of the best CPU architects and engineers on the planet, developing the processors that will power the future. Come and join us on this exciting adventure. Sharpen your formal verification skills to their fullest on some of the complex designs ever attempted.
• Roles and Responsibilities:
• Work with design team to understand design intent and bring up verification plans and schedules with an eye towards the end-to-end formalization of the refinement from architecture to micro-architecture
• Define formal verification architecture, develop test plans and build end-to-end formal sign-off environments for Qualcomm CPU components
• Engage in full-spectrum deployment of model-checking technology to hardware designs including property verification, math proofs, architectural modeling and validation amongst other cutting-edge application areas
• To be successful in this position you will need:
• BA/BS degree in CS/EE with 8+ years of practical experience in application of formal methods in hardware or software
• Strong model checking or theorem proving background/experience in verification of complex systems
• Experience in writing assertions and associated modeling code in Hardware Description Languages or in proving correctness of architectural specifications using formal methods
• Working familiarity with model checkers like Jaspergold and VC-Formal or theorem-proving tools such as ACL2 and HOL
• The ideal candidate will have the following experience:
• MS/PhD degree in CS/EE; 4+ years of practical experience
• Strong foundation in formal methods and in their application to hardware specifications and/or implementations
• Domain knowledge in one or more of these areas: Microprocessor architecture and micro-architecture, instruction set architecture, floating-point math, memory consistency, memory coherency, security architectures
• Strong software engineering skills with proven ability in automation and proficiency in at least one programming language (C++, Python, TCL etc.)

Job Description Summary
Join Broadcom, a global technology leader and Fortune 500 powerhouse at the forefront of semiconductor innovation and AI infrastructure. Within our specialized Mixed-Signal ASIC division, we offer an exciting position in the explosive growth area of Data Center Enterprise Storage, where we build the critical IP responsible for providing low-power, high-performance analog and mixed-signal products. In this role, you will develop advanced semiconductor devices to support high-capacity storage needs across all top-tier service providers. You will work with highly talented teams to meet company business goals while growing your skills.
We are looking for a Senior Digital IC Design or Mixed-Signal Verification Engineer to act as a methodology leader and key technical bridge for our worldwide engineering organization. This unique opportunity allows you to drive quality initiatives, pioneer modern automation (including AI-assisted workflows), and establish robust methodologies across our US and Asia design centers.

Key Responsibilities
• Act as the primary technical liaison between local US design teams and global cross-functional teams, translating complex specifications into seamless execution.
• Provide technical support through all phases of product development: testing, yield analysis, characterization, reliability analysis, qualification, and release to manufacturing.
• Adhere to strict schedule, die size, and power commitments.
• Conduct detailed design reviews with internal and external customers.

Digital IC Design:
• Define system requirements, digital control functions, and block partitions for next-generation preamplifier products.
• Perform digital logic design, Verilog coding, logic synthesis, formal verification, static timing analysis, and place and route.
• Support integrating the digital core with analog circuitry into a completed integrated circuit.
• Perform transistor-level high-speed digital IC design for custom cells and blocks.

Digital Mixed Signal Verification:
• Architect, develop, and maintain advanced UVM-based testbenches for the functional verification of complex mixed-signal ASICs.
• Own verification efforts at both the block and system levels for major tape-out projects, driving functional and code coverage to closure.
• Champion verification quality by integrating new methodologies (e.g., SVA, UVM/OVM) to reduce mixed-signal validation bottlenecks.
• Lead initiatives to explore and integrate modern automation and AI-assisted verification workflows to accelerate testbench generation and debug efficiency.

Qualifications & Skills

Core Requirements (All Candidates):
• Education/Experience: Bachelors in Engineering and 8+ years of related experience; or Masters degree in Engineering and 6+ years of related experience
• Communication: Excellent spoken and written communication skills, and the proven ability to coordinate technical problem-solving across global teams.
• Analytical: Proven ability to apply advanced math and physics to solve complex engineering problems.
• Bonus: An understanding of silicon process technologies (CMOS and Bipolar) and device physics is a strong plus. Expertise across both design and verification domains is highly desired.

Specialized Skills (Design Focus):
• Strong hands-on experience with ASIC EDA tools used in synthesis, simulation, static timing analysis, formal verification, and place & route.
• Deep familiarity with Verilog/VHDL RTL coding and logic design.

Specialized Skills (Verification Focus):
• Deep expertise in coverage-driven verification processes and frameworks (UVM/OVM).
• Strong understanding of event-driven simulator-based modeling techniques and how digital logic interacts with analog boundaries.
• Hands-on experience with SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) and behavioral modeling of analog circuits.
• Proficiency in scripting (Python, Perl, TCL, etc.) to automate verification workflows, manage regressions, and streamline simulation infrastructure.

Why Broadcom?
Beyond our highly competitive compensation and RSU packages, this role is based in our Mendota Heights, MN or Broomfield, CO design centers. Job Description:
The CSG group at Broadcom has brought some of the most complex and cutting edge networking ASIC's and multichip solutions to market over the last decade. The group
develops Tomahawk ASICs for Scale-Out and Scale-Up AI Networks. These products support the latest networking protocols and features as well as manage extremely large volumes of traffic of the order of several hundreds of Terabits/sec. These networking ASIC's support a large number of ports ranging from 10/100Mb/s to 1600Gb/s speeds as well as various line interfaces and protocols.
The successful candidate will be responsible for various key tasks in the areas of verification of cutting edge network switch routing designs. The daytoday tasks for this position include but are not limited to the following:
1) Participating in the verification processes of L2/L3 Network Switching and routing ASICs and various subsystems within these chips
2) Understanding the architecture and implementation of these chips and coming up with in depth test plans for verifying various key networking features such as L2/L3 traffic streaming, traffic management, scheduling and shaping of traffic, latency and performance characterization of chips and systems.
3) Developing verification environments including testbenches and verification API’s associated with the chip architecture to enable testing of various features within the chips as well as scripts and Makefiles as required to run the environment in various tool chains
4) Implementing test plans into executable test suites using a cutting edge Systemverilog verification environment.
5) Executing the verification process to completion pre-silicon using various functional and code coverage metrics as measures of completion

The successful candidate will satisfy the following requirements:
1) MSEE or BSEE or equivalent, with concentration in digital design and excellent academic standing. Total engineering minimum experience required is typically a BS degree and 8+
years of experience, an MS degree and 6+ years of experience or a PhD and 3+ years of experience or equivalent.
2) Familiar with Hardware description languages (Verilog/SystemVerilog/UVM), scripting languages (Perl, Python) and Object Oriented Programming (OOP).
3) Exposure to cutting edge verification and validation techniques and methodologies using Object Oriented modular reusable environments in languages such as Systemverilog,
Perl, Python
4) Strong understand and prior experience of end-to-end verification process from test plan definition to coverage closure on ASIC/SOC silicon that has gone into mass production
5) Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Job Description:

Design Verification Engineer
Broadcom's ASIC Products Division (APD), a worldwide leader in the design of complex custom ASICs and embedded IP, is looking for an experienced verification engineer that will be responsible for modeling and verification activities related to complex digital and mixed signal (MXS) IP blocks used in Broadcom’s ASIC developments.
The engineer will be responsible for defining verification plans and environment architecture, developing test cases and test bench components, coverage analysis and closure, and debug. This position may involve working with emulation and FPGA prototyping platforms and leading efforts in evaluating and driving the adoption of advanced verification methodologies/flows. The engineer will be expected to develop functional models to facilitate the block, system, and ASIC level verification. The candidate must work closely with the design teams and EDA vendors to accomplish the modeling and verification tasks.
The candidate must have experience using SystemVerilog and UVM, designing verification components including UVM agents, checkers, and behavioral models. Experience with implementing and achieving coverage goals by developing random & directed test cases, and SystemVerilog Assertions. This engineer will be responsible for analyzing and debugging simulation failures at the RTL and gate-level. The engineer must be knowledgeable of RTL, gate-level netlists, and SDF and capable of analyzing such formats in the verification context.

Requirements:
• 12+ years of experience with verification concepts and architectures for complex digital and MXS circuits
• Experience verifying designs at the block and system levels.
• Experience with complex digital and mixed-signal circuits (PLL, DLL, ADC, DAC)
• Experience debugging RTL and gate-level netlists, analyzing schematic diagrams of analog / MXS circuits
• Experience using SystemVerilog and advanced verification concepts and methodologies (UVM, SVA)
• Experience with Synopsys, Cadence, and Mentor simulations tools
• Demonstrated ability to plan and deploy complex, reusable, and scalable verification environments
• Experience with Perl/Python and Tcl or other scripting languages
• Experience with version control systems (DesignSync, git)
• Superior writing, grammar, and verbal communication skills
• Excellent problem solver; develops and employs automated processes where applicable
• Worked independently and in a global team and dynamic environment in a highly visible role
• Possesses ability to learn and adapt to new tools and methodologies on the fly
• Must have legal authorization to work in the US

It is a plus if the candidate has expertise in one or more of the following areas:
• Experience with hardware design and debug
• Experience with emulation (Palladium, Veloce, Zebu) and FPGA (Xilinx) platforms
• Formal verification concepts / experience is a plus
• Experience with verifying iJTAG network using ICL and PDL in the Tessent tool a plus
• Experience with co-simulation a plus

Education and Experience required:
• BS in Electrical Engineering / Computer Engineering and 12+ years of related experience; or an MS in Electrical Engineering / Computer Engineering and 10+ years of related experience.

As a Staff GPU Design Verification Engineer – Formal Verification, you will contribute to block and subsystem level formal verification for Samsung's next-generation mobile GPU.

jobs.description:
Change the world. Love your job.
Texas Instruments is seeking a Design Verification Engineer to join our Analog Power Products organization in Knoxville. In this role, you will develop and execute verification strategies that ensure first-pass silicon success for next-generation analog and mixed-signal ICs across industrial, automotive, and consumer applications.
As a Design Verification Engineer, you will work across the full verification cycle – from developing detailed verification plans and building test benches through running coverage regressions, tracking closure, and contributing to continuous improvements in DV methodology – collaborating closely with digital design and systems engineering teams.

Responsibilities include:
• Develop detailed verification plans while working closely with the design and system team to ensure first-pass silicon success
• Develop test benches, tests, and simulations at RTL and gate-level (GLS) for the entire chip
• Run coverage regressions to meet defined coverage goals
• Track and communicate verification status, issues, and concerns
• Work with regression tools and develop scripts to submit cases for regression analysis
• Contribute to continuous improvements for quality and efficiency on DV strategy, tools, methods, and flows

Minimum requirements:
• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical and Computer Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
• 1+ years of experience in design verification or a related role

Preferred qualifications:
• Experience with functional verification methodologies including simulation, assertions, and coverage-driven verification
• Proficiency in SystemVerilog and UVM-based testbench development
• Experience with Mixed Signal verification a plus
• Experience with System Verilog real number models a plus
• Familiarity with RTL simulation tools (Cadence Xcelium, Synopsys VCS, or equivalent)
• Experience with gate-level simulation and timing-aware verification flows
• Scripting skills for regression automation and verification flow development (Python, Tcl, or Perl)
• Ability to establish strong relationships with key stakeholders critical to success, both internally and externally
• Strong verbal and written communication skills
• Demonstrated strong interpersonal, analytical, and problem-solving skills
• Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions
• Ability to take the initiative and drive for results

jobs.description:
Change the world. Love your job.
The Battery Charging Products group at Texas Instruments is looking for a candidate that is interested in working in a challenging, fast-paced environment. As a Design Verification Engineer-AMS you will get to directly interact with one of TI's high-volume and high-impact customers and will help architect new TI battery charger products and make our customers’ visions a reality. You will define, design, model, and document digital cores for battery management devices. We are looking for a self-motivated, highly driven AMS Verification Engineer to make an immediate impact on current developments, and help us grow market share in a competitive, constantly changing market.
TI offers an extraordinary culture, competitive benefits, professional development opportunities and collaboration coupled with a social responsibility. A career at TI provides the chance to work with some of the world's most dynamic technologies that help people learn, grow, connect and discover.

What will you be doing in this role?
• Verification Strategy: Develop detailed coverage-driven Verification Plans by collaborating closely with System, Application, and Analog Design teams.
• Modelling & Simulation: Create high-fidelity Analog behavioral models using Verilog-A, Verilog-AMS, Wreal (RNM), to enable efficient top-level simulation.
• Environment Development: Build and enhance mixed signal testbenches using a combination of schematic, models, and RTL.
• Checkers & Assertions: Implement real-time analog checkers and post-processing checker strategies to ensure functional correctness.
• Full-Cycle Verification: Execute RTL and Gate Level Simulations (GLS), running regressions and tracking functional coverage goals until tape-out.
• Collaboration: Work with Digital DV Team, Analog Designers, and Post-Silicon Validation teams to debug complex issues and ensure successful product delivery.

Basic Requirements (Must-Haves)
• Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering (EE) or Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE)
• Experience: Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in Analog Mixed-Signal (AMS) design verification.
• Modelling Skills: Proficiency in analog behavioral modelling using System Verilog, Verilog-AMS, Verilog-A, or Wreal.
• Verification Flow: Direct experience with mixed-signal verification involving a combination of schematic, behavioral models, and RTL.
• Tool: Strong command of Cadence Virtuoso/AMS Designer toolsets and debug environments or other standard mixed-signal simulation tools
• Communication: Clear ability to present technical analysis and conclusions to internal stakeholders and business leaders.
• Excellent self-organizing and time management skills.

Preferred Skills & "Good to Have" (Innovation & Automation)
• Advanced DV: Knowledge of UVM, as the top-level environments are built on these frameworks.
• Automation: Proficiency in scripting (Python, Perl, or Shell) to automate simulation flows and data analysis. Exposure and interest in building AI-driven verification methodologies.
• Domain Expertise: Experience in signal processing, PMICs, or high-speed communication interfaces.
• Silicon Interaction: Experience in silicon debug and working alongside silicon validation teams.
• Standard protocols exposure: Verification experience with I2C, SPI, UART etc.

jobs.description:
Change the world. Love your job.
Texas Instruments is seeking Design Verification Engineer. In this position, you will be working on advanced mixed-signal sensor circuits using state-of-the art process technology, as well as be involved in the digital and AMS verification of high-performance digital circuits interfacing to leading edge analog circuitry as part of an overall system.
In this role, your responsibilities will include the following.
• Develop detailed Verification/Test plans using specifications to cover all the digital/analog functionality/features of a mixed-signal chip for our next generation designs.
• Develop SystemVerilog chip-level testcases based on the verification plan.
• Simulation, Testcase debug and Verification closure for the digital/analog functionality of Mixed-signal chips, at chip-level in digital and AMS environment.
• Finding design bugs with break-the-design mindset and ensuring design is bug-free and robust.
• Develop SystemVerilog based behavioral models for the analog blocks and integrate them in the chip-level verification environment.
• Running regressions and DV closure activities.
• Work closely with design and systems teams to review/close spec gaps and design bugs, as they arise.
• Design for testability using ad-hoc, Full scan, IDDQ, VBOX, ATPG, BIST
• Drive documentation, reviews and verification flow improvement strategies.
• Be proactive in risk assessment and drive solutions to mitigate them.

Minimum requirements:
• Masters degree in Electrical Engineering or related field.
• 3+ years of related experience.
• Strong hands on working experience in Digital/AMS verification for Mixed-signal chips.
• Strong programming skills using SystemVerilog in verification.
• Robust in verification approach and strong in fundamentals of DV flows and concepts.
• SystemVerilog and class-based verification knowledge.

Preferred qualifications:
• Experience in writing an exhaustive verification plan from the specs.
• Experience in chip-level testcases in SystemVerilog.
• Experience in metric-based Verification closure using Code and Functional coverage.
• Experience in random/constrained random verification.
• Experience with Cadence simulation and debug tools.
• Experience with UART, SPI, I2C communication protocols.
• Good in debugging skills.
• Ability to work independently and self-driven/motivated person.

Senior Analog/Mixed-Signal (AMS) Design Verification Engineer

About the Role
As a Senior Analog/Mixed-Signal (AMS) Design Verification Engineer at Analog Devices, you will own verification planning and execution for complex mixed-signal integrated circuits and subsystems. You will translate specifications into scalable verification architectures, develop reusable SystemVerilog/UVM and real-number modeling solutions, and drive coverage closure across digital, analog, and mixed-signal interfaces. Working independently with minimal supervision, you will partner with analog, digital, modeling, firmware, and validation teams to identify risk early, resolve complex failures, and deliver robust products from pre-silicon verification through silicon bring-up.

Key Responsibilities
• Verification Strategy and Planning: Own feature-based verification plans, requirements traceability, risk assessment, test strategy, and sign-off criteria for complex AMS IP, subsystems, and SoCs.
• AMS Verification Architecture: Architect scalable, reusable verification environments that combine SystemVerilog/UVM, analog behavioral models, real-number models, and mixed-signal simulation.
• Modeling and Abstraction: Develop and validate behavioral models in SystemVerilog real-number modeling, Verilog-AMS, or equivalent languages to accelerate full-chip verification while maintaining model fidelity.
• Test and Check Development: Create constrained-random and directed tests, scoreboards, reference models, assertions, monitors, and functional coverage for analog-digital interactions, control loops, power modes, calibration, and fault conditions.
• Coverage and Sign-Off: Define measurable code, functional, assertion, and requirements coverage goals; analyze gaps; drive closure; and communicate verification readiness and residual risk.
• Debug and Root-Cause Analysis: Lead cross-domain debug using waveforms, logs, assertions, schematics, and analog measurements to isolate failures involving timing, power sequencing, connectivity, modeling, and design behavior.
• Regression and Automation: Build reliable regression flows, triage infrastructure, dashboards, and automation that improve simulation throughput, reproducibility, and engineering productivity.
• Cross-Functional Execution: Collaborate closely with analog and digital designers, architects, firmware engineers, model developers, and post-silicon validation teams throughout the product lifecycle.
• Technical Leadership: Mentor engineers, lead reviews, establish verification best practices, and influence methodology, tool, and reuse decisions across projects.

Must Have Skills
• SystemVerilog and UVM: Advanced proficiency building reusable agents, sequences, scoreboards, reference models, assertions, and coverage components for block-, subsystem-, and SoC-level verification.
• Analog/Mixed-Signal Fundamentals: Strong understanding of analog circuits and specifications, including sampling, quantization, noise, offset, gain, settling, linearity, clocking, feedback, calibration, and process-voltage-temperature effects.
• AMS Modeling: Hands-on experience with real-number modeling and behavioral model development using SystemVerilog real/wreal, Verilog-AMS, Verilog-A, or comparable abstraction techniques.
• Mixed-Signal Simulation: Experience configuring and debugging analog, digital, and mixed-signal simulations using industry-standard simulators and understanding accuracy-versus-performance tradeoffs.
• Verification Planning and Coverage: Proven ability to convert specifications into executable verification plans and achieve requirements, functional, assertion, and code coverage closure.
• Verification Techniques: Expertise in constrained-random, coverage-driven, assertion-based, and directed verification, including negative testing and corner-case analysis.
• Power-Aware Verification: Working knowledge of power-state transitions, reset and startup sequences, clock and power-domain crossings, low-power intent, and verification of UPF-defined behavior.
• Scripting and Automation: Strong Python proficiency and working knowledge of Tcl, Perl, shell, or similar languages for regressions, data analysis, failure triage, and flow automation.
• Debug and Data Analysis: Demonstrated ability to diagnose complex cross-domain failures using simulation waveforms, logs, assertions, coverage reports, and quantitative data analysis.

Job Title: Principal Digital Verification Engineer
Primary Location: Chandler, Arizona, USA
Role Summary: The Advanced Power Systems group within NXP’s Power and Energy Business Line is seeking a Senior Digital Verification Engineer to develop next-generation Power Management ICs (PMICs) for automotive and industrial applications. This role will lead digital verification from architecture review through verification signoff, ensuring functionality, quality, reliability, and compliance.

Job Responsibility:
• Lead digital verification activities and drive successful project execution from planning through signoff.
• Define verification plans, methodologies, environments, regressions, coverage goals, and signoff criteria.
• Review product requirements, architecture specifications, microarchitecture, interfaces, and implementation plans.
• Develop and maintain advanced verification environments using SystemVerilog, UVM, VIPs, scoreboards, monitors, checkers, and assertions.
• Create directed and constrained-random test scenarios to validate functionality, performance, robustness, and corner-case behavior.
• Define, implement, and analyze functional, code, and assertion coverage; drive coverage closure and signoff.
• Apply SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA), formal verification methodologies, and regression analysis to identify and resolve issues.
• Verify PMIC digital control, telemetry, diagnostics, safety, power sequencing, fault management, communication interfaces, and embedded control functions.
• Deliver verification collateral including test plans, environments, assertions, regressions, coverage reports, metrics, milestones, and requirements traceability.
• Drive methodology improvements, automation, reuse, and productivity while mentoring junior engineers and collaborating across global teams.

Job Qualification:
• BSEE with 8+ years, MSEE with 5+ years, or PhD with 3+ years of semiconductor industry experience.
• Strong understanding of digital design fundamentals, FSMs, CDC, reset architecture, low-power design, and SoC integration.
• Expertise in Verilog, SystemVerilog, UVM/OVM, and class-based verification methodologies.
• Strong knowledge of constrained-random, coverage-driven verification, regression automation, and verification signoff.
• Hands-on experience developing testbenches, drivers, monitors, scoreboards, assertions, and reusable verification IP.
• Experience with SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA), formal verification techniques, and low-power verification methodologies such as UPF/CPF.
• Knowledge of industry-standard protocols including AMBA, I²C, SPI, UART, CAN, LIN, DDR, and PCIe.
• Proficiency in Python, Perl, and UNIX/Linux shell scripting for automation.
• Familiarity with FPGA, emulation, or prototyping platforms such as HAPS, Palladium, or Zebu is a plus.
• Understanding of PMIC architectures and power management concepts is highly desirable.
• Experience using AI/LLM-based technologies to improve engineering productivity is a plus.
• Strong analytical, debugging, problem-solving, communication, leadership, mentoring, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Key responsibilities in your new role:

jobs.description:
Job Description

ob Description
• As a Mixed-Signal Verification Engineer, you will be responsible for the verification and modeling of mixed-signal power management devices, including PMICs, battery chargers, switching regulators, and related analog IP. You will work closely with design, systems, verification, CAD, and customer teams to drive successful development, integration, and sign-off of complex mixed-signal power chips.
• Verification: Lead chip-level verification of analog and mixed-signal circuits using AMS and DMS methodologies, integrating analog behavioral models with digital RTL and UVM-based environments. Develop verification strategies, drive coverage closure, and support product tapeout milestones.
• Modeling: Create, maintain, and validate behavioral models using SystemVerilog RNM and Verilog-AMS, translating circuit and system requirements into high-performance models suitable for both AMS co-simulation and full-chip DMS verification. Ensure model accuracy through correlation against specifications and schematic references across operating conditions.
• Verification Plan Development: Develop and execute comprehensive verification and modeling plans with full traceability from design requirements through coverage closure and tapeout sign-off. Track verification readiness and proactively identify risks to product schedules.
• Debugging: Own debug and root-cause analysis of mixed-signal verification issues, including failing test cases, model inaccuracies, analog-digital interface problems, convergence issues, and simulation performance bottlenecks. Drive resolution across design, modeling, and verification teams.
• Technical Leadership & Collaboration: Partner with analog and digital designers, system architects, verification engineers, and CAD teams to improve modeling accuracy, simulation efficiency, and verification quality. Participate in architecture and design reviews, influencing design decisions to improve verification effectiveness and reduce project risk.
• Design Review & Optimization: Participate in design reviews to evaluate circuit topology and design partitioning from a verification and modeling perspective, recommending architectural choices that simplify behavioral modeling, improve simulation convergence, and reduce verification risk. Support silicon validation and root-cause analysis of complex system-level issues by correlating simulation predictions to bench measurements.
• Documentation: Document verification plans, model validation methodologies, coverage results, and sign-off metrics to ensure clear communication and traceability throughout the product lifecycle.
• Customer Interaction: Interface directly with external customers to present verification status, review coverage results, address technical questions, and ensure verification deliverables meet product and customer requirements.

Qualifications
• Education: B.S. or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
• Experience: 8-12+ years of experience in mixed-signal verification, AMS/DMS simulation, behavioral modeling, power management IC development, or related semiconductor design activities. Strong experience with switching regulators, battery chargers, PMICs, SystemVerilog, Verilog-AMS, UVM, Cadence Xcelium, Spectre, and mixed-signal verification sign-off methodologies is highly desirable. Experience developing behavioral models and debugging complex analog-digital interactions is a plus.
• Communication: Strong communication, teamwork, and customer-facing skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate across cross-functional engineering teams and present technical information to both internal and external stakeholders.

Additional Information
Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.
We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

jobs.description:

As mixed-mixed signal verification engineer you will be responsible for the verification and modeling of mixed-signal Automotive power management devices, including PMICs, switching regulators, and related analog IP. • Design and architect mixed-signal verification environments, including Real Number Model (RNM) and AMS (Analog Mixed Signal) model integration for PMIC designs
• Develop and implement comprehensive verification plans and strategies for automotive PMIC products, ensuring compliance with automotive safety standards (ISO 26262, AEC-Q200)
• Lead debugging activities for complex analog blocks including switched-mode regulators, Linear Dropout (LDO) regulators, and mixed-signal interfaces
• Set up and optimize Gate-Level Simulation (GLS) flows, correlating with RTL simulation results to identify and resolve discrepancies
• Conduct in-depth RTL and Gate-Level simulations, analyzing timing, power, and functional correctness across process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) corners
• Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams: Design, Application Engineering, ATE (Automatic Test Equipment), and Silicon Validation to ensure seamless verification handoffs
• Troubleshoot and debug complex design issues involving interactions between analog and digital domains using simulation and measurement techniques
• Drive continuous improvement of verification tools, methodologies, and infrastructure, evaluating emerging verification technologies and AI-based solutions
• Create and maintain comprehensive verification documentation, test plans, and coverage metrics

Qualifications
• MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
• 8+ years of experience in mixed-signal or analog circuit verification
• Deep understanding of all aspects of mixed-signal verification environment architecture and implementation
• Hands-on experience with Real Number Model (RNM) and AMS (Analog Mixed Signal) model integration
• Proficiency in RTL and behavioral simulation tools (e.g., Spectre, Xcelium)
• Strong understanding of Gate-Level Simulation (GLS) flows and ability to set up and debug GLS simulations
• Proven expertise debugging both analog blocks (switched-mode regulators, LDO, bandgap, reference circuits) and digital RTL
• Experience with automotive PMIC or power management IC design and verification
• Proficiency in Verilog, SystemVerilog, and/or SPICE-based languages
• Solid understanding of verification methodologies: UVM, assertions, coverage-driven verification
• Experience interfacing with multiple verification domains: functional, post-silicon, ATE test correlation
• Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills with strong analytical mindset

jobs.description:

We are looking for an experienced Senior or Staff Verification Engineer to play a key role in the functional verification of complex digital ICs for automotive and industrial applications. jobs.description:
Job Description
We are seeking a Principal Design Verification Engineer to provide technical leadership for verification of next-generation semiconductor memory interface products, including data buffer silicon.
This role will drive verification strategy and execution for complex digital designs, working closely with design teams to ensure functionality, performance, and product requirements are met. The ideal candidate brings deep semiconductor verification expertise with SystemVerilog and UVM. Previous DDR or memory experience is an advantage, but is not required.
This is an opportunity to take significant technical ownership while contributing to next-generation DDR6 technology.
Key Responsibilities
• Lead verification strategy and execution for complex semiconductor designs at the block and system level.
• Define verification methodologies, test plans, coverage strategies, and verification environments.
• Architect, develop, maintain, and optimize SystemVerilog/UVM testbenches and verification environments.
• Drive test development, functional coverage, checkers, constrained-random verification, and coverage closure.
• Take technical ownership of verification for assigned blocks, features, and environments from planning through signoff.
• Work closely with RTL and design engineers to ensure designs meet functional and performance requirements and are effectively verifiable.
• Analyze specifications, design implementation, and verification results to identify functional gaps and design issues.
• Drive debugging and resolution of complex verification failures.
• Develop scalable and reusable verification components, methodologies, and best practices.
• Identify and lead improvements in verification efficiency, quality, performance, and reuse.
• Participate in architecture, feasibility, design, and technical reviews.
• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to verification engineers.
• Serve as a technical expert for assigned verification methodologies and tools.
• Communicate verification progress, coverage, technical risks, and readiness to engineering leadership and project stakeholders.

Qualifications
Required Qualifications
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
• Extensive experience in semiconductor design verification, with demonstrated technical ownership of complex verification efforts.
• Expert-level proficiency with SystemVerilog.
• Significant hands-on experience with UVM (Universal Verification Methodology), including development and optimization of UVM-based verification environments.
• Experience defining verification strategies and developing verification plans from design and product specifications.
• Strong experience with functional verification, constrained-random testing, functional coverage, checkers, debugging, and coverage closure.
• Experience partnering closely with RTL/design engineering teams throughout the verification lifecycle.
• Demonstrated ability to independently solve complex verification and design problems.
• Ability to provide technical leadership and mentoring within a verification team.
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with DDR, memory interfaces, memory controllers, data buffers, or related semiconductor technologies.
• Experience with DDR4 and/or DDR5.
• Verification experience with complex high-speed interfaces, protocols, or mixed-signal semiconductor products.
• Experience leading verification efforts through coverage closure and signoff.

Job Description:
Join the dsPIC Microcontroller Business Unit, IP Verification Engineering team as Engineer II-Verification, doing IP level verification, testbench architecture, modeling, simulation, coverage, regression, formal or dynamic simulation (UVM tests), debugging, signoff evidence, and lifecycle support. This role is best suited for candidates with 2.5–5 years of relevant experience in IP design verification, testbench architecture, modeling, simulation, coverage, regression, formal or dynamic simulation, debugging, signoff evidence, and lifecycle support.
In this role, you will independently execute defined assignments and structured troubleshooting, partner with cross-functional teams (architecture, design, product development , validation, and application) across the USA, India, and other global corporate teams to deliver robust verification results, timely project execution, and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities:
• Architect, develop, and maintain UVM based verification environments and/or Formal verification environments.
• Collaborate with architecture, designer, validation, and applications teams to verify IP and product requirements.
• Develop and maintain verification plans, test strategies and testbenches.
• Develop constraint random tests and testbench, assertions and coverage, analyze coverage metrics and drive coverage closure.
• Develop Formal properties, analysis proof results and drive Formal coverage closure.
• Configure, execute, and maintain UVM simulation and/or Formal regressions.
• Debug failures in RTL and testbench, perform root-cause analysis, and collaborate with design and architecture teams to resolve the defects.
• Leverage AI-assisted and machine-learning based automation to improve verification quality, accelerate development and debugging, and reduce verification cycle time.

Requirements/Qualifications:

Minimum qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, Engineering, or a related field with 2.5–5 years of relevant experience in design verification, UVM and/or Formal testbench architecture, modeling, simulation, coverage, regression, debugging, signoff evidence, and lifecycle support.
Qualified candidates should demonstrate verification architecture, modeling, and simulation, UVM and Formal testbench development, coverage analysis, structured debugging, AI/ML automation, technical documentation, and cross-functional influence.

• Employment stability, reliability, and sustained accountability in prior roles.
• Effective teamwork and cross-functional collaboration.

• Hands-on experience with UVM-based simulation and/or Formal verification methodologies and tools.
• Strong proficiency in System Verilog language, constrained-random verification, assertions, and coverage.
• Experience developing and maintaining IP level and SoC level verification environments.
• Experience with simulation, regression execution, coverage analysis, debug, verification signoff, and lifecycle support.
• Experience with verification automation and scripting using Python or Perl.
• Experience with AI assisted technologies to improve verification productivity, quality, and driver faster coverage closure.
• Strong understanding of digital design concepts, RTL fundamentals, and ARM or common SoC architectures.

jobs.title: FPGA IP Design and Verification Engineer
requirements: 7+ years of experience in Semiconductor IP Design verification.
Familiarity with HDL languages (VHDL, Verilog, SystemVerilog).
Experience or knowledge in scripting languages such as Tcl, Perl, or Python.
Prior experience or exposure to FPGA tools (Quartus or Vivado) would be advantageous.
Strong willingness to learn new skills and technologies.
Ability to work collaboratively within a team environment.
jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description:
Performs functional logic verification of an FPGA to ensure design will meet specification requirements. Develops FPGA verification plans, test benches, and the verification environment to ensure coverage to confirm to microarchitecture specifications. Executes verification plans and defines and runs system simulation models to verify the FPGA design, analyze power and timing, and uncover bugs. Replicates, root causes, and debugs issues in the pre-silicon environment. Finds and implements corrective measures to resolve failing tests. Collaborates with FPGA architects, RTL developers, and physical design teams to improve verification of complex architectural and microarchitectural features. May also collaborate with systems and software engineers to support integration testing of the FPGA. Documents test plans and drives technical reviews of plans and proofs with design and architecture teams. Maintains and improves existing functional verification infrastructure and methodology. Documents, reviews, and executes the verification strategy plan on different methodologies/techniques (e.g., gate-level-simulation strategy, power patterns/aware simulations) used to enable feature coverage as per the microarchitecture specifications.

Qualifications:
• 7+ years of experience in Semiconductor IP Design verification.
• Familiarity with HDL languages (VHDL, Verilog, SystemVerilog).
• Experience or knowledge in scripting languages such as Tcl, Perl, or Python.
• Prior experience or exposure to FPGA tools (Quartus or Vivado) would be advantageous.
• Strong willingness to learn new skills and technologies.

• Collaborate with SoC integration, firmware, post-silicon validation, and customer engineering teams

• Hands-on experience with analog/mixed-signal co-simulation and Real Number Modeling (RNM)
• Working knowledge of one or more high-speed serial protocols: PCIe, UALink, UCIe, Ethernet, or CXL

• Experience verifying PCIe Gen 6/Gen 7, UALink, or UCIe SerDes/PHY IP
• Familiarity with emulation platforms (Palladium, Veloce, or ZeBu) and gate-level simulation flows
